mainEntity.name: How much does a Nissan X-Trail e-POWER Hybrid engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A complete reconditioned Nissan X-Trail e-POWER Hybrid engine typically costs between £3,000 and £4,500 for supply only, while fully rebuilt units range from £4,000 to £6,000. Used engines are available from around £1,500.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of hybrid system or engine failure in a Nissan X-Trail e-POWER?

acceptedAnswer.text: Engine or hybrid system failure in the Nissan X-Trail e-POWER Hybrid usually presents as a loss of power, hybrid system warning lights, or the vehicle defaulting to a restricted "limp mode".

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Nissan X-Trail e-POWER Hybrid?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a Nissan X-Trail e-POWER Hybrid (2021-present) valued between £22,000 and £35,000, a full rebuilt engine is a financially sound investment.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Nissan X-Trail e-POWER Hybrid engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard supply and fit for a Nissan X-Trail e-POWER Hybrid engine typically takes 1 to 2 days once the engine has been delivered to the specialist workshop.

mainEntity.name: What engine code is in the Nissan X-Trail e-POWER Hybrid?

acceptedAnswer.text: The primary engine code for the Nissan X-Trail e-POWER Hybrid is KR15DDT.

milestones.description: KR15DDT introduced, 1.5L VC-Turbo petrol engine paired with twin electric motors, producing a combined 213 PS (157 kW) for the T33 X-Trail e-POWER.

items.question: What are the signs of hybrid system or engine failure in a Nissan X-Trail e-POWER?
items.answer: Engine or hybrid system failure in the Nissan X-Trail e-POWER Hybrid usually presents as a loss of power, hybrid system warning lights, or the vehicle defaulting to a restricted "limp mode".

The vehicle may struggle to maintain speed or fail to start the hybrid sequence.
Ignoring these signs can lead to secondary internal engine or inverter damage.
